title: Gustav Klimt, Portrait of Fräulein Lieser, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Lost masterpiece returning to the art market after almost 100 years Art painting sold at auction in Vienna for 30 million euros New coin series dedicated to the legacy of Gustav Klimt Decorated with an amber insert A new coin collection dedicated to Gustav Klimt, one of the most influential artists of the Vienna Secession, showcases his significant works. The series begins with the „Portrait of Miss Lieser,” a masterpiece thought to be lost for nearly a hundred years, recently rediscovered and presented to the public. Alongside it, the collection will feature coins with other iconic Klimt works. This exclusive series is a unique opportunity for collectors and art lovers alike.
